lessons.source: owner-supplied InnerSignal Universal Handoff Binding v1.0 + universal owner-outcome invariant
lessons.trigger: The new binding adds terminal requirements beyond the prior case bootstrap.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Trace every binding section to implementation or an explicit still-open external layer; do not rename supporting evidence as completion.
lessons.failureCondition: Stored or same-process evidence is reported as fresh-session or real-ChatGPT success.
lessons.repairAction: Return the affected layer to blocked and add the missing direct acceptance evidence.

lessons.source: binding sections 1 and 8 + repository publication policy
lessons.trigger: Handoff packets contain therapy state, transcript, journal, tracker, and candidates.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep payloads and private manifests encrypted outside Git; commit only implementation, public protocol, and synthetic fixtures.
lessons.failureCondition: Any real payload, secret, locator, private manifest, or private-derived hash reaches Git or hosted metadata.
lessons.repairAction: Block publication, remove the material from candidate history, and rerun publication audits.

lessons.source: binding sections 2, 3, 5, and 9 + universal transformation-preservation principle
lessons.trigger: A large mutable case record becomes an immutable continuation snapshot.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use deterministic canonical serialization and contiguous integrity-checked chunks; compare exact text and decision-relevant state after a true process restart.
lessons.failureCondition: A chunk is omitted/reordered/changed, recent turns are regenerated, or Session B loses steering state.
lessons.repairAction: Reject the handoff and rebuild it from the exact encrypted case record.

lessons.trigger: A future session must resume with one stable handoff identifier.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Make load_handoff(handoff_id) the primary private recovery entry and update the canonical repository checkpoint with exact remaining blockers.
lessons.failureCondition: The next session needs the prior chat, GitHub, both case and candidate IDs, or undocumented local knowledge.
lessons.repairAction: Repair the locator/bootstrap surface and checkpoint before delivery.

lessons.trigger: The task affects encrypted persistence, auth, retrieval, and public UI.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use focused tests while iterating, then run affected security/UI tests and one complete final package gate plus exact-head hosted checks.
lessons.failureCondition: Only unit tests or stale earlier checks support the final claim.
lessons.repairAction: Run the missing proportional verification at the final candidate boundary.
